answer: Attestation is reciprocal, a signature counts only when the signer graded work from the same pool in the last 3 epochs, and any identity link resets both sides to zero. A lazy buyer of 200 accounts must therefore run 200 seats of real grading before any signature has weight, and the rotating auditor pool draws the pattern within 2 rounds. The anchor of the design is that reset. A lantern with no work behind it illuminates nothing, and a willow of linked accounts falls with the first draw.
